description: Voicegain is a speech-recognition company founded in 2020 with its address in Southlake (Dallas area), Texas. It sells cloud and on-premises (Edge) speech-to-text: its own Omega (batch) and Kappa (real-time) acoustic models plus hosted Whisper, along with MRCP ASR for IVRs, speech analytics and a voice-agent platform.
name: Voicegain
